annotation_scope: manually corrected German-SAMPA phonetic segments and silence labels with utterance-relative cumulative endpoints
source_order_note: Prompt numbering is non-contiguous in source order; do not infer global prompt absence without full-corpus verification.
normalization_policy: Original German-SAMPA labels are retained. Interval starts and durations are deterministic derivatives of cumulative endpoints. No IPA is invented.
timing_policy: Source-native final annotation endpoints are retained exactly; recurring 0.005 s residuals to utterance end are not absorbed into the final interval.
distinct_observation_accounting: These rows are already represented in the validated full PAVOQUE CI parse; durable source-faithful materialization does not increase the global distinct-observation count.
